text: Assumption: Parallel read calls are thread-safe without synchronization — is this correct?

norm: parallel read calls are thread safe without synchronization
assumption: Parallel read calls are thread-safe without synchronization.
rationale: The crbegin() method is declared as const and noexcept and produces no side effects (SWS_CORE_01978).
